name: card
title: Card
description: Surface composition with header, content, footer, and interactive variants.

.caps-card.--caps-card-resting-shadow:
var(
      --stipe-shadow-raised,
      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.14)),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.06)),
      0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.06)),
      0 14px 28px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.28))
    )

.caps-card-interactive.transition:
border-color var(--stipe-motion-fast) ease,
      transform var(--stipe-motion-normal) var(--stipe-motion-ease),
      box-shadow var(--stipe-motion-normal) ease
